rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown:
Message cost is variable, so longer messages are more expensive than shorter messages. 

| Type | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------|------|------|
| Input | $0.18/1M tokens | 6 points/1k tokens |
| Output (text) | $1.09/1M tokens | 36 points/1k tokens |
| Output | $0.0091/search | 300 points/search |
| Bot message | $0.053/message | 1750 points/message |
| Cache discount | 90% discount on [cached chat](https://help.poe.com/hc/en-us/articles/19944206309524-Poe-FAQs#h_01JMDGNARXH8B0MN452N6N7XHP) |  |


Web searches will add input tokens.

Input rate is 2x and output rate is 1.5x when context is >272k tokens.

When new content is written to the cache, it costs 25% more points than the original input and stays stored for 5 minutes before automatically expiring.
